scripts.build: pnpm catalog:build && pnpm expressions:build && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test: pnpm catalog:build --quiet && pnpm expressions:build --quiet && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm catalog:build --quiet && pnpm expressions:build --quiet && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=4 run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.e2e: pnpm catalog:build --quiet && pnpm expressions:build --quiet && playwright test
scripts.e2e:screens: pnpm catalog:build --quiet && pnpm expressions:build --quiet && HEADCOUNT_SCREENS=1 playwright test e2e/screens.spec.ts
